claims.text:
oh-story-dsh 是基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）构建的社区插件，将 Oh Story 的小说方法库与 Drama Skills 的短剧生产流程带入 DSH。DSH 管理 Agent、会话、模型、权限和 Chat；插件提供创作 Skills、专业 Roles、项目协议与三栏工作台。
本项目与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属、合作或背书关系；DeepSeek Harness 名称与品牌素材归其权利人所有。
覆盖长篇、短篇、选题、扫榜、拆文、导入、审稿、去 AI 味与封面流程。13 个 Oh Story Skills 与 7 个专业 Roles 按固定上游版本随插件交付。
内置 Drama Skills 0.6.0 的 creator-first 工作流。每集按请求维护最多五份可读 Markdown：剧本.md、视觉设定.md、分镜.md、图片提示词.md、视频提示词.md；不预建空文档，也不倒补用户未点名的阶段。审查与生产交付继续使用 DSH 原生工具、权限和确认界面。
Drama Skills 0.6.0 是破坏性升级：v0.5 结构化项目应继续锁定 v0.5 并只读保留；迁移时新建项目根，逐集人工确认当前工作所需文档，不要在同一目录混用旧 JSON/JSONL 与新文档。
- 原生三栏布局：项目文件树、编辑器与官方 Chat 同屏，Trajectory、工具执行、Todo、审批和 Composer 保持 DSH 原生交互。
- 实时文件跟随：Agent 调用官方文件工具时，目标文件自动定位，编辑器同步呈现生成中的内容。
- Chat 文件导航：点击官方 Chat 中的作品文件名，文件树会定位并在编辑器打开对应文件。
- 创作文档预览：Markdown 支持标题、表格、任务列表、引用和代码块；JSONL 以带行号、类型和状态的结构化记录呈现。
- 安全编辑：支持源码编辑与快捷保存；人工未保存内容不会被并发 Agent 修改覆盖。
- 稳定长对话：消息区独立滚动，官方 Composer 固定在 Chat 栏底部。
需要 Node.js 24+。
1.

items.title: Structure for Reading, Prose for Writing: Asymmetric Structural Conditioning in Multi-Agent Document Authoring
items.one_liner: Converting instructions from prose to nested XML drops multi-agent document generation quality from 74% to 48%.
items.summary: Multi-agent pipelines authoring formal documents face an asymmetric conditioning problem regarding structural markup versus natural prose. While rendering documents as structural markup improves text extraction, converting a bid's instruction material from prose to nested XML dropped answer quality from 74% to 48% in a deployed tender-response system. Furthermore, naming a forbidden construction concentrates defects rather than removing them, as 96% of surviving defects fell into the two explicitly named forms. Evaluation of the system against human-submitted bids showed that an LLM judge rated answers at least as good on 40 of 55 ground-truth sections, with 68% of identified gaps stemming from missing source knowledge rather than writing quality.
items.bottom_line: Structural markup aids information extraction in multi-agent pipelines, but forcing structural conditioning onto writing prompts degrades overall output quality.

claims.text:
市面上绝大多数所谓的「AI 深度调研」，本质是 Wide Research：并行搜一堆来源，按主题分好类，给你一份工整的 checklist。看起来很全，事实也没错，但没用——它只有目录，没有判断。
这个 skill 把 Agent 掰到另一条路上：Deep Research。精读一手源，把它们之间的矛盾挑出来，最后落到一个业内人真的会跟你争论的判断上。
Wide Research 是 LLM 的出厂设置，产出的是「正确的废话」。这个 skill 就是一套护栏，把它从默认模式里拽出来。
一套四阶段工作流，以及比工作流更重要的东西：不让 Agent 跳过 Phase 0 的纪律。
Phase 0　元思考 — 绝不外包
一次搜索都还没发起，先拷问问题本身：为什么问这个？隐藏假设是什么？有没有一个「显而易见但其实不对」的标准答案，而这篇报告的全部价值就是说清它为什么不对？然后写下「好答案」该长什么样：核心论点摆到一屋子业内人面前得能吵起来，而不是集体点头。
Phase 1　一手源精读
找到那 3 到 5 篇真正的原始文献（财报、创始人自己写的博文、电话会议逐字稿、论文原文），完整读完。二手总结每转一手，洞见就蒸发一层。
Phase 2　对比与反例
选 2 到 3 个案例做深度对比，专门去挖失败案例和批评声音。收敛本身是发现，分歧背后的原因是更大的发现。
Phase 3　交叉验证
多源印证的可信，单源的标注存疑，互相矛盾的——这才是最有意思的地方，去分析这个矛盾意味着什么。
Phase 4　把论证写出来
段落优先于表格，每一章只推进一个论点，诚实标注不知道的部分。最后一道自检：如果核心结论放到业内不会引发任何争论，重写。
这个文件最值钱的部分是「翻车目录」：把 Agent 最容易走的捷径一条条写下来，每条都配一个检测信号，让你（或 Agent）当场判断是不是正在犯。
1 · 跳过 Phase 0 直接搜 没有假设引导，subagent 返回的是信息碎片，不是论证素材。
检测信号：subagent 的 prompt 里没有「假设」或「待验证的论点」。
2 · 拿 subagent 的返回结构当报告骨架 你会得到一个伪装成分析的主题目录。
检测信号：章节标题拿去当搜索关键词刚好合适（「定价对比」「适合谁」）——那是文件柜，不是论证。
3 · 用表格和 bullet 替代思考 一个洞见如果能塞进表格，它大概率不是洞见。
检测信号：删掉所有表格和 bullet 后，剩下的段落撑不起一篇文章。
4 · 结论太安全 「A 适合新手，B 适合老手」这种话不用调研就能说。
检测信号：核心结论发到专业群里，没人会出来反驳或讨论。
5 · 把「全面」当「深度」 10 个维度各 3 句，输给 3 个维度各 3 段。
检测信号：报告过万字，但核心论点三句话就能说完。
6 · 子 agent 递归 fan-out 一次真实事故就是这条规则的由来：主 agent 派 3 个 → 变 13 个 → 变 50+ → 最终 149 个 agent，一笔意外的 API 账单。
检测信号：你在给子 agent 的 prompt 里写了「你可以用 Agent 工具进一步搜索」。停，马上要炸。
1.

items.title: Dollar higher after Iran sanctions, loonie drops after US announces tariff increases
items.one_liner: The US dollar strengthened as trade tensions rose over new Canadian tariffs and expanded secondary sanctions against Iran.
items.summary: The US dollar advanced on Monday following the announcement of expanded secondary sanctions on Iran by the Treasury Department and steep tariff increases on Canadian goods. Washington announced a 50% tariff starting in 2027 on all cars, trucks, automotive parts, and steel from Canada, prompting Canada to promise dollar-for-dollar retaliation. Meanwhile, the Canadian dollar weakened significantly, while market participants awaited key personal consumption expenditures data and Federal Reserve remarks.
items.bottom_line: Aggressive US tariff increases on Canada and tightening sanctions on Iran are fueling currency market volatility and boosting the US dollar.

claims.text: The U.S. dollar advanced on Monday, coming off its third weekly decline in four that sent the greenback to three-month lows after President Donald Trump's administration announced an expansion of sanctions on Iran and separate tariffs on goods from Canada.
claims.support_span: The U.S. dollar advanced on Monday, coming off its third weekly decline in four that sent the greenback to three-month lows after President Donald Trump's administration announced an expansion of sanctions on Iran and separate tariffs on goods from Canada.

claims.text: Trade tensions weighed on the Canadian dollar, which weakened 0.61%, its biggest drop since June 17, versus the greenback to C$1.385 per dollar...

items.title: Android Car Malware Spreads Through Built-In Updaters for Ad Fraud, Proxy Botnet
items.one_liner: The MoYu Group is weaponizing legitimate Android automotive update channels for ad fraud, marking a shift toward targeting vehicle infotainment systems.
items.summary: Kaspersky researchers have identified 'JarService' malware targeting Android-based vehicle head units manufactured by DoFun. The malware is distributed through the legitimate 'TWCore' system app's update mechanism, which uses an MQTT server to push malicious APKs. Once installed, the multi-stage downloader enlists the device into a proxy botnet and performs ad fraud, leveraging the unit's internet connectivity. This campaign is attributed to the MoYu Group, previously linked to the BADBOX botnet, and represents the first documented case of an infection chain specifically tailored for automotive head units.
key_facts: Infection Vector: TWCore system app via cardoor[.]cn
items.bottom_line: Android car head units are being targeted by sophisticated malware that exploits legitimate system update apps to build proxy botnets.

claims.text: The MoYu group used a legitimate update app to spread malware to car head units.
claims.support_span: A supply-chain attack targeting Android-based car head units is using a legitimate device-update app to spread malware that enlists compromised devices in a proxy botnet or uses them for ad fraud.

items.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills
items.one_liner: ACES is a new framework for evaluating enterprise agent skills via paired live trials and quantitative Skill Lift measurements.
items.summary: Enterprise agent programs moving into production require rigorous evaluation of reusable skills and tool packages rather than simple structure and style scans. To address this, researchers developed ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills), a repository-native framework that runs paired live trials with and without target skills. It normalizes trajectories into the Agent Trajectory Interchange Format, measures six default runtime metrics, and reports a Skill Lift score. Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 production skills, the mean composite Skill Lift is 0.2134.
items.bottom_line: Static code scans fail to predict real-world agent skill performance, which can now be reliably measured via live trials using frameworks like ACES.

claims.text: Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy?
claims.support_span: Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy?

items.title: World models of environment, agent and joint agent-environment systems
items.one_liner: Computational mechanics reveals how world model structures change when categorizing by environment, agent, and joint system channels.
items.summary: World models in model-based reinforcement learning are generally discussed in terms of their predicted variables, but they also differ based on which channel they model: environment, agent, or joint system. Using computational mechanics, researchers defined canonical predictive models as epsilon-transducers or epsilon-machines for these three cases. They demonstrated that canonical support-restricted environment states factor through canonical joint causal states, with transition structures induced directly from the joint model. Furthermore, a POMDP example shows that an unrestricted environment model with infinite states can become finite when coupled with a support-restricted model.
items.bottom_line: Distinguishing environment, agent, and joint channels clarifies the predictive structure and complexity of model-based reinforcement learning world models.

claims.text: World models are a central component of model-based reinforcement learning. They are usually discussed in terms of what variables they predict, such as observations, rewards, states, latent or information states.
claims.support_span: World models are a central component of model-based reinforcement learning. They are usually discussed in terms of what variables they predict, such as observations, rewards, states, latent or information states.

claims.text: We consider three cases: the environment channel O_: | A_:, the agent channel A_: | O_:, and the realised joint process (A, O)_:, equivalently viewed as a channel with no inputs.

items.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
items.one_liner: ARQ uses an agentic LLM refinement loop over synthesized C/C++ programs to automatically fix CodeQL query false positives and negatives.
items.summary: Static analyzers like CodeQL rely on query patterns that often suffer from false positives and false negatives in C/C++ vulnerability detection. Researchers propose ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines CodeQL queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized C/C++ programs without requiring labeled datasets or commit history. By running an LLM-based refinement loop, ARQ repairs queries based on execution disagreements. When evaluated on the Juliet v1.3 and FormAI v2 datasets using commercial models like GPT-5.4, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and Gemini-3.5-flash, ARQ-refined queries detected up to 119.8% more true positives while maintaining over 98.0% precision, successfully fixing long-standing GitHub issues and discovering new bugs in libpng and zlib.
key_facts: True positive detection increase: up to 119.8%
Target libraries with newly discovered bugs: libpng and zlib
items.bottom_line: Execution-grounded agentic refinement can dramatically improve static analysis query accuracy, uncovering previously undetected bugs and resolving long-standing issues.

claims.text: We compare both ARQ-refined and original CodeQL queries on the Juliet v1.3 and FormAI v2 datasets and show that ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8%, with a Precision of at least 98.0% throughout.
claims.support_span: We compare both ARQ-refined and original CodeQL queries on the Juliet v1.3 and FormAI v2 datasets and show that ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8%, with a Precision of at least 98.0% throughout.

items.title: Cybercriminals Turn GTA VI Leaks Into Malware Bait
items.one_liner: A classic social engineering campaign using high-profile media leaks to trick users into disabling their own security software.
items.summary: Threat actors are exploiting the massive hype surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI by distributing fake 100GB+ playable builds that contain malware. One analyzed 113GB file was found to be mostly empty data with a 50KB malicious payload that attempts to whitelist the C: drive in Windows Defender and terminate security software. These scams leverage real leaks from actors like CyberLeek to gain credibility. Other variants include fake mobile apps and phishing pages designed to steal Rockstar Social Club credentials or deploy infostealers.
items.bottom_line: There is no legitimate playable build of GTA VI; any such download is a high-risk malware delivery mechanism.

claims.text: The malware attempts to whitelist the entire C: drive in Windows Defender.
claims.support_span: The decompiled bytecode literally contains commands to whitelist the entire C:\ drive in Windows Defender (powershell Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath %SystemDrive%\) and kill security software (taskkill -f).

claims.text: Scammers are using fake GTA 6 mobile apps to spread infostealers.
claims.support_span: They also found a fake “GTA 6 Mobile” app that redirects users to a domain linked to infostealers and ransomware.
